55: /**
56:  * This class facilitates interaction with Coordinator/Overlord leader nodes. Instance of this class is injected
57:  * via Guice with annotations @Coordinator or @IndexingService .
58:  * Usage:
59:  * Request request = druidLeaderClient.makeRequest(HttpMethod, requestPath)
60:  * request.setXXX(..)
61:  * FullResponseHolder responseHolder = druidLeaderClient.go(request)
62:  */
63: public class DruidLeaderClient
64: {
65:   private final Logger log = new Logger(DruidLeaderClient.class);
66: 
67:   private static final int MAX_RETRIES = 5;
68: 
69:   private final HttpClient httpClient;
70:   private final DruidNodeDiscoveryProvider druidNodeDiscoveryProvider;
71:   private final NodeRole nodeRoleToWatch;
72: 
73:   private final String leaderRequestPath;
74: 
75:   private LifecycleLock lifecycleLock = new LifecycleLock();
76:   private DruidNodeDiscovery druidNodeDiscovery;
77:   private AtomicReference<String> currentKnownLeader = new AtomicReference<>();
78: 
79:   public DruidLeaderClient(
80:       HttpClient httpClient,
81:       DruidNodeDiscoveryProvider druidNodeDiscoveryProvider,
82:       NodeRole nodeRoleToWatch,
83:       String leaderRequestPath
84:   )
85:   {
86:     this.httpClient = httpClient;
87:     this.druidNodeDiscoveryProvider = druidNodeDiscoveryProvider;
88:     this.nodeRoleToWatch = nodeRoleToWatch;
89:     this.leaderRequestPath = leaderRequestPath;
90:   }
91: 
92:   @LifecycleStart
93:   public void start()
94:   {
95:     if (!lifecycleLock.canStart()) {
96:       throw new ISE("can't start.");
97:     }
98: 
99:     try {
100:       druidNodeDiscovery = druidNodeDiscoveryProvider.getForNodeRole(nodeRoleToWatch);
101:       lifecycleLock.started();
102:       log.debug("Started.");
103:     }
104:     finally {
105:       lifecycleLock.exitStart();
106:     }
107:   }
108: 
109:   @LifecycleStop
110:   public void stop()
111:   {
112:     if (!lifecycleLock.canStop()) {
113:       throw new ISE("can't stop.");
114:     }
115: 
116:     log.debug("Stopped.");
117:   }

119:   /**
120:    * Make a Request object aimed at the leader. Throws IOException if the leader cannot be located.
121:    */
122:   public Request makeRequest(HttpMethod httpMethod, String urlPath) throws IOException
123:   {
124:     Preconditions.checkState(lifecycleLock.awaitStarted(1, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS));
125:     return new Request(httpMethod, new URL(StringUtils.format("%s%s", getCurrentKnownLeader(true), urlPath)));
126:   }

128:   public StringFullResponseHolder go(Request request) throws IOException, InterruptedException
129:   {
130:     return go(request, new StringFullResponseHandler(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
131:   }

133:   /**
134:    * Executes a Request object aimed at the leader. Throws IOException if the leader cannot be located.
135:    */
136:   public <T, H extends FullResponseHolder<T>> H go(Request request, HttpResponseHandler<H, H> responseHandler)
137:       throws IOException, InterruptedException
138:   {
139:     Preconditions.checkState(lifecycleLock.awaitStarted(1, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS));
140:     for (int counter = 0; counter < MAX_RETRIES; counter++) {
141:       final H fullResponseHolder;
142:       try {
143:         try {
144:           fullResponseHolder = httpClient.go(request, responseHandler).get();
145:         }
146:         catch (ExecutionException e) {
147:           Throwable cause = e.getCause();
148:           if (cause instanceof IOException) {
149:             throw (IOException) cause;
150:           }
151:           if (cause instanceof ChannelException) {
152:             throw (ChannelException) cause;
153:           }
154:           throw new RE(e, "HTTP request to[%s] failed", request.getUrl());
155:         }
156:       }
157:       catch (IOException | ChannelException ex) {
158:         // can happen if the node is stopped.
159:         log.warn(ex, "Request[%s] failed.", request.getUrl());
160:         try {
161:           final String refreshedLeader = currentKnownLeader.accumulateAndGet(
162:               null,
163:               (current, given) -> {
164:                 Iterator<DiscoveryDruidNode> discoveredNodes = druidNodeDiscovery.getAllNodes().iterator();
165:                 if (!discoveredNodes.hasNext()) {
166:                   return null;
167:                 }
168:                 DiscoveryDruidNode discoveredNode = discoveredNodes.next();
169:                 String scheme;
170:                 if (discoveredNode.getDruidNode().getTlsPort() >= 0) {
171:                   scheme = "https";
172:                 } else {
173:                   scheme = "http";
174:                 }
175:                 String hostAndPortToUse;
176:                 if (discoveredNode.getDruidNode().isEnableTlsPort()) {
177:                   hostAndPortToUse = HostAndPort.fromParts(
178:                       discoveredNode.getDruidNode().getHost(),
179:                       discoveredNode.getDruidNode().getTlsPort()
180:                   ).toString();
181:                 } else if (discoveredNode.getDruidNode().isEnablePlaintextPort()) {
182:                   if (discoveredNode.getDruidNode().getPlaintextPort() < 0) {
183:                     hostAndPortToUse = HostAndPort.fromString(
184:                         discoveredNode.getDruidNode().getHost()
185:                     ).toString();
186:                   } else {
187:                     hostAndPortToUse = HostAndPort.fromParts(
188:                         discoveredNode.getDruidNode().getHost(),
189:                         discoveredNode.getDruidNode().getPlaintextPort()
190:                     ).toString();
191:                   }
192:                 } else {
193:                   hostAndPortToUse = null;
194:                 }
195:                 String rawLeader = StringUtils.format("%s://%s", scheme, hostAndPortToUse);
196:                 if (hostAndPortToUse == null || hostAndPortToUse.isEmpty()) {
197:                   return rawLeader;
198:                 }
199:                 try {
200:                   URI parsedLeader = URI.create(rawLeader);
201:                   if (parsedLeader.getScheme() == null) {
202:                     return rawLeader;
203:                   }
204:                   if (parsedLeader.getAuthority() == null) {
205:                     return rawLeader;
206:                   }
207:                   return StringUtils.format("%s://%s", parsedLeader.getScheme(), parsedLeader.getAuthority());
208:                 }
209:                 catch (IllegalArgumentException ignored) {
210:                   return rawLeader;
211:                 }
212:               }
213:           );
214:           if (refreshedLeader == null) {
215:             throw new IOE("No known server");
216:           }
217:           final URL currentUrl = request.getUrl();
218:           final String path = currentUrl.getPath();
219:           final String query = currentUrl.getQuery();
220:           if (query == null) {
221:             URL rebuiltUrl = new URL(StringUtils.format("%s%s", refreshedLeader, path));
222:             Request rebuiltRequest = new Request(request.getMethod(), rebuiltUrl);
223:             for (Map.Entry<String, Collection<String>> headerEntry : request.getHeaders().asMap().entrySet()) {
224:               rebuiltRequest.addHeaderValues(headerEntry.getKey(), headerEntry.getValue());
225:             }
226:             if (request.hasContent()) {
227:               rebuiltRequest.setContent(request.getContent());
228:             }
229:             request = rebuiltRequest;
230:           } else {
231:             URL rebuiltUrl = new URL(StringUtils.format("%s%s?%s", refreshedLeader, path, query));
232:             Request rebuiltRequest = new Request(request.getMethod(), rebuiltUrl);
233:             for (Map.Entry<String, Collection<String>> headerEntry : request.getHeaders().asMap().entrySet()) {
234:               rebuiltRequest.addHeaderValues(headerEntry.getKey(), headerEntry.getValue());
235:             }
236:             if (request.hasContent()) {
237:               rebuiltRequest.setContent(request.getContent());
238:             }
239:             request = rebuiltRequest;
240:           }
241:           continue;
242:         }
243:         catch (MalformedURLException e) {
244:           // Not an IOException; this is our own fault.
245:           throw new ISE(
246:               e,
247:               "failed to build url with path[%] and query string [%s].",
248:               request.getUrl().getPath(),
249:               request.getUrl().getQuery()
250:           );
251:         }
252:       }
253: 
254:       HttpResponseStatus responseStatus = fullResponseHolder.getResponse().getStatus();
255:       int statusCode = responseStatus.getCode();
256:       if (HttpResponseStatus.TEMPORARY_REDIRECT.equals(responseStatus)) {
257:         String redirectUrlStr = fullResponseHolder.getResponse().headers().get("Location");
258:         if (redirectUrlStr == null) {
259:           throw new IOE("No redirect location is found in response from url[%s].", request.getUrl());
260:         }
261: 
262:         log.info("Request[%s] received redirect response to location [%s].", request.getUrl(), redirectUrlStr);
263: 
264:         final URL redirectUrl;
265:         try {
266:           redirectUrl = new URL(redirectUrlStr);
267:         }
268:         catch (MalformedURLException ex) {
269:           throw new IOE(
270:               ex,
271:               "Malformed redirect location is found in response from url[%s], new location[%s].",
272:               request.getUrl(),
273:               redirectUrlStr
274:           );
275:         }
276: 
277:         currentKnownLeader.set(StringUtils.format(
278:             "%s://%s:%s",
279:             redirectUrl.getProtocol(),
280:             redirectUrl.getHost(),
281:             redirectUrl.getPort()
282:         ));
283:         request = withUrl(request, redirectUrl);
284:       } else if (statusCode >= 200 && statusCode < 300) {
285:         return fullResponseHolder;
286:       } else if (statusCode >= 300 && statusCode < 400) {
287:         return fullResponseHolder;
288:       } else if (statusCode >= 400 && statusCode < 500) {
289:         return fullResponseHolder;
290:       } else {
291:         return fullResponseHolder;
292:       }
293:     }
294: 
295:     throw new IOE("Retries exhausted, couldn't fulfill request to [%s].", request.getUrl());
296:   }
297: 
298:   public String findCurrentLeader()
299:   {
300:     Preconditions.checkState(lifecycleLock.awaitStarted(1, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS));
301:     final StringFullResponseHolder responseHolder;
302:     try {
303:       responseHolder = go(makeRequest(HttpMethod.GET, leaderRequestPath));
304:     }
305:     catch (Exception ex) {
306:       throw new ISE(ex, "Couldn't find leader.");
307:     }
308: 
309:     if (responseHolder.getStatus().getCode() == 200) {
310:       String leaderUrl = responseHolder.getContent();
311: 
312:       //verify this is valid url
313:       try {
314:         URL validatedUrl = new URL(leaderUrl);
315:         currentKnownLeader.set(leaderUrl);
316: 
317:         // validatedUrl.toString() is returned instead of leaderUrl or else teamcity build fails because of breaking
318:         // the rule of ignoring new URL(leaderUrl) object.
319:         return validatedUrl.toString();
320:       }
321:       catch (MalformedURLException ex) {
322:         log.error(ex, "Received malformed leader url[%s].", leaderUrl);
323:       }
324:     }
325: 
326:     throw new ISE(
327:         "Couldn't find leader, failed response status is [%s] and content [%s].",
328:         responseHolder.getStatus().getCode(),
329:         responseHolder.getContent()
330:     );
331:   }
332: 
333:   private String getCurrentKnownLeader(final boolean cached) throws IOException
334:   {
335:     final String leader = currentKnownLeader.accumulateAndGet(
336:         null,
337:         (current, given) -> current == null || !cached ? pickOneHost() : current
338:     );
339: 
340:     if (leader == null) {
341:       throw new IOE("No known server");
342:     } else {
343:       return leader;
344:     }
345:   }
346: 
347:   @Nullable
348:   private String pickOneHost()
349:   {
350:     Iterator<DiscoveryDruidNode> iter = druidNodeDiscovery.getAllNodes().iterator();
351:     if (iter.hasNext()) {
352:       return iter.next().toLeaderBaseUrl();
353:     }
354: 
355:     return null;
356:   }
357: 
358:   private Request withUrl(Request old, URL url)
359:   {
360:     Request req = new Request(old.getMethod(), url);
361:     req.addHeaderValues(old.getHeaders());
362:     if (old.hasContent()) {
363:       req.setContent(old.getContent());
364:     }
365:     return req;
366:   }

- Extracted the cache-refresh/request-rebuild logic (previously only in the `IOException | ChannelException` path) into `rebuildRequestWithRefreshedLeader`, now shared by both the exception path and the 5xx path.
